textual.observation: The source promotes a Lowe's coupon worth between $5 and $500 and asks viewers in specified regions to text a keyword to a phone number to receive it.

evidence.quote: Just send a text to the number in the video and you WILL get at least $5 but maybe as much as $500!
If you're in the Eastern Central Mountain time zones, text spring to the following number. If you are in the Pacificific Hawaii or Alaska areas text april now the number he said it to is 78133

textual.context: Presented as a promotional offer associated with Lowe's. The speaker demonstrates sending the text and describes the offer as time-limited.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised monetary-value coupon is directly linked to texting a specified keyword to a phone number, with regional targeting and a stated time limit.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish who controls the phone number, whether the offer was authorized, whether viewers received the stated coupon, or what information or permissions the text interaction may involve.

visual.observation: A message instructs viewers to send a text to the short code "78133," followed by a claim that everyone wins between "$5 - $500" during a stated time window.
visual.context: Presented alongside a Lowe's store image and an animated bear character; the supplied frames do not clarify whether this is an official promotion, quotation, demonstration or other context.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated monetary reward is directly linked to contacting a specified short code, with a stated time window, creating a reward/contact-action relationship that merits review.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot establish the sender's identity, whether the short code is active, whether anyone receives a reward, or whether the displayed Lowe's branding authorizes the offer.

visual.observation: A messaging interface shows a received message beginning with "Congratulations! Click the link below to see your coupon," followed by a visible external-looking link whose full address is not legible in the sampled frame.
visual.context: The message is shown within a sequence depicting the previously advertised text interaction; surrounding visuals prominently display Lowe's branding.
visual.potential_relevance: A coupon or reward is linked to clicking a destination reached through a text message, creating a promised-benefit and external-destination relationship that merits review.
visual.limitations: The full link, destination, sender identity, and any resulting page or transaction cannot be verified from this frame; the sampled sequence does not establish that a click occurred.

visual.observation: The video displays a page headed "Your Lowe's Spring Saturday coupon is here!" with Lowe's branding and a visible coupon, after the text-message sequence.
visual.context: The page is presented as the apparent destination of the text-message offer and uses Lowe's name and logo; the supplied frames do not establish whether the page is official or simulated.
visual.potential_relevance: A branded coupon destination is linked in the video sequence to a promised monetary reward and text-message action, creating an identity/endorsement and reward-destination relationship that merits review.
visual.limitations: The page's authenticity, terms, coupon validity, and relationship to Lowe's cannot be established from the sampled image.

visual.observation: An end card instructs viewers to share the video and press the like button while repeating "Everyone Wins!"
visual.context: The engagement request appears after the text-message and coupon sequence; no eligibility terms or explanation of how sharing or liking affects the reward are visible.
visual.potential_relevance: A monetary or coupon-related outcome previously framed as universal is paired with requested sharing and liking, creating a reward/engagement relationship that merits review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not establish whether engagement is required, whether it changes eligibility, or whether any reward is delivered.
